unit: Original canonical advertisement; preserve all10000 original members and labels.
frame: complete_fixed10k; prior9282 and Formal800 estimates unchanged
weight: 1 per advertisement for this observed-sample descriptive extension. Store original nested-design weights unchanged but do not use them to claim population inference for sample-selected company support.
company: Unique nonmissing vendor COMPANY_ID, exact decimal/string identity; do not consolidate names or ultimate parents.
occupation: Existing verified SOC major only; retain fixed majors11,13,15,17. No title classifier or new occupational mapping.
structural_support: Valid unconflicted company and occupation, at least one known-group A ad and one known-group B ad. Unknown groups and metadata remain in the coverage ledger, not negative labels.

Q1.usable_cell: Structural support and at least one outcome-known ad in each group; this is availability, not a semantic quality or sample-size certification.
Q1.cell_rate: Positive / outcome-known ads in each group; zero positives valid, zero denominators unavailable.
Q1.within_major_weight: For each outcome-specific supported cell, pooled count of all known A+B ads in that cell, including outcome-unknown ads, divided by its sum over supported cells in that major. Same weights applied to both groups.
Q1.overall: Average of the four within-major contrasts with .25 each; any mandatory major unavailable => overall unavailable, no renormalization.
Q1.unknown_bounds: Optional recorded outcome-unknown bounds within exactly the retained sample cells and fixed cell weights; do not include technology-unknown or excluded cells implicitly, or label them full-target bounds.
Q1.required_counts: Per-major structural and per-outcome usable cells, ads/contexts/companies, exclusions, positive/known/unknown in both groups, cell-size distributions and singleton/zero-positive counts.

Q2.eligibility: Unchanged graduate_or_noexperience, preserving the existing inclusion of conditional/unconditional cases.
Q2.support: Structural common-company/major cells with at least one eligibility-positive and outcome-known ad, pooling A+B; do not require or add a two-group Q2 contrast.
Q2.within_major_weight: Pooled count of eligibility-positive ads in each supported cell, including duty-unknown, divided by the sum over supported cells of that major.
Q2.overall: Four majors .25 each; absent required major => unavailable without renormalization.
Q2.unknown_bounds: Recorded duty-unknown bounds only among eligibility-positive ads in retained supported cells. Eligibility-unknown members separately counted and not treated as ineligible.
Q2.counts: Eligibility-positive, eligibility-unknown, duty-known/positive/unknown and supported/excluded cells; duties may overlap.

inference: Descriptive values and recorded-field unknown bounds only, no new CIs or causal regression. One-ad cells are explicitly disclosed, not promoted to robust comparisons.
privacy: Private cell-level tables may contain source keys/company IDs/titles; public tables aggregate by major/measure and omit all company IDs, names and raw titles.
stop: Empty or sparse support is a result, not permission to merge companies, remap occupations, relax definitions, sample again or fit a model. Complete the specified outputs and stop.
